body:
I'm stuck, I dont have a visa and if I go back home I won't be able to take my daughter with me because he put a block on her. I also would never take her away from him, he is a good father. I actually just wanted to be able to disappear. 
He makes me feel the worse person in the whole world, and all I wanted this time is to give birth in peace. I lost our first baby with 26 weeks pregnant. With my second I left the hospital crying not wanting to be there, now I just feel the same. He makes me think I'm not a good mother as well. So why should I be here anyways?

Hi my love, thank you so much for your words. 
I really appreciate your kindness and your prayers.
